title: Software Engineer, Platform - Delhi, India
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.



Over 50 million people use Speechify's text\-to\-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text\-to\-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.


Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.


**Overview**



The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.



This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast\-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.



We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.



Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.


**What Yo****u'****ll Do**


* Design, develop, and maintain robust APIs including public TTS API, internal APIs like Payment, Subscription, Auth and Consumption Tracking, ensuring they meet business and scalability requirements
* Oversee the full backend API landscape, enhancing and optimizing for performance and maintainability
* Collaborate on B2B solutions, focusing on customization and integration needs for enterprise clients
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to align backend architecture with overall product strategy and user experience


**An Ideal Candidate Should Have**


* Proven experience in backend development: TS/Node (required)
* Direct experience with GCP and knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud providers
* Efficiency in ideation and implementation, prioritizing tasks based on urgency and impact
* Preferred: Experience with Docker and containerized deployments
* Preferred: Proficiency in deploying high availability applications on Kubernetes


**What We Offer**

* A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products
* A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive
* Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity
* The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry
* Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture
* The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more
* An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio – a rapidly evolving tech domain


**Think you're a good fit for this job?**



Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
  

And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.


**Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?**



Refer them!


**Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.**



Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Senior Software Developer (Java)

**NICE\-TO\-HAVE**
------------------

* Full stack awareness and front\-end tech like React, JavaScript, etc.

MongoDB.  
*

-----------------


We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. title: Data Developer - Robotics IS Data Platform
description:
**Company Description** **Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.**


Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.


With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.


Focused on S/4HANA, Data \& Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.


Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision\-making, our client\-first and open\-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.


At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game\-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

 **Job Description** **Role Purpose**


The Data Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration, data warehousing, and analytics solutions within the Robotics IS Data Platform. The role enables reliable and scalable access to enterprise data by building efficient data pipelines, optimizing data models, and supporting business intelligence and analytics initiatives. Working closely with data engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and application teams, the Data Developer ensures high\-quality data delivery across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration solutions.
* Build and optimize data models, data warehouses, and analytics datasets to support reporting and business intelligence requirements.
* Develop and tune complex SQL queries to ensure efficient and reliable data processing.
* Integrate data from enterprise systems, including SAP S/4HANA and other business applications.
* Support the implementation and operation of cloud\-based data platforms, including Snowflake and related technologies.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver scalable data solutions.
* Contribute to data quality, governance, documentation, and best practices across the data platform.
* Support modernization initiatives involving advanced analytics, big data, and machine learning use cases.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 3 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT development.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL, including query optimization and data modeling techniques.
* Experience with modern data integration and extraction tools such as Azure Data Factory (ADF), Qlik Replicate, SSIS, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehousing platforms.
* Proficiency in C\#, or a comparable backend programming language, for data integration and service development.
* Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA data extraction and integration concepts or experience working with enterprise ERP systems.
* Understanding of big data, analytics, and machine learning concepts.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Fluent English with a customer\-oriented and solution\-focused mindset.

  

**Additional Information** **WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:**


At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat\-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.


You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross\-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.


Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

* **Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients**, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
* **Drives delivery excellence**, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
* **Encourages entrepreneurial thinking**, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
* **Operates with a truly global mindset**, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

**WHAT WE OFFER \- FUSION BENEFITS**


We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well\-being, and global mobility.

**Growth \& Development**

* Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
* Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
* Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
* Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

**Recognition \& Reward**

* Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
* Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.
* Stay Rewarded: Access loyalty\-based benefits starting from your third year via the Unity Scheme.

**Global Mobility \& Local Support**

* Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
* Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
* Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
**Req ID:** 388230
  
  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  

We are currently seeking a ServiceNow Developer to join our team in Delhi, Delhi (IN\-DL), India (IN).
  
  

**Job Title:** ServiceNow Platform Solution Consultant (Scrum Master certified)
  
**Location:** Onsite
  
  

**Role Overview:**  

NTT DATA is seeking a dynamic and experienced ServiceNow Platform Solution Consultant who combines deep technical expertise with strategic advisory capabilities. This role involves hands\-on configuration and development across all major ServiceNow modules, while also contributing to pre\-sales efforts including proposal development and crafting Statements of Work (SOWs). The ideal candidate will be a trusted advisor to clients, helping them maximize their ServiceNow investments through strategic roadmaps, platform governance, and process optimization.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Advise and support the GMF team throughout the migration to the newer HAM Pro version.
* Assist with the setup, configuration, and implementation of the new HAM environment.
* Provide technical guidance and recommend best practices for deployment and operations.
* Provide KT to upskill the existing team.
* Enable the current team to effectively manage, maintain, and support the new HAM Pro environment after the migration.


Client Engagement Delivery Support
  
We are seeking an experienced ServiceNow Hardware Asset Management Professional (HAM Pro) Consultant to lead the end\-to\-end design of HAM Pro. This position will utilize GMF’s existing platform and process teams to guide configuration and implementation of HAM Pro within the GMF Environment. This role requires a hands\-on expert who can bridge current\-state operational processes with ServiceNow HAM Pro capabilities, enabling a fully functional, lifecycle\-driven hardware asset management solution. The consultant will work closely with internal teams who understand existing processes and translate that into a configured, optimized solution aligned to ServiceNow best practices. Key Responsibilities
  
1\. Current\-State Assessment • Engage with stakeholders across ITSM, asset management, procurement, and operations to understand existing hardware asset lifecycle processes • Document current workflows covering request, procurement, receiving, inventory/stockroom, assignment, refresh, return, and retirement • Identify gaps in data quality, process efficiency, controls, and reporting
  
2\. HAM Pro Capability Alignment • Provide expertise on ServiceNow HAM Pro capabilities and how they map to current processes • Educate stakeholders on out\-of\-box functionality vs configuration vs customization • Recommend standardized approaches aligned with ServiceNow best practices • Define opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve controls, and increase automation
  
3\. Future\-State Design • Design end\-to\-end hardware asset lifecycle workflows within ServiceNow • Define: o Lifecycle states and transitions o Stockroom and inventory model o Asset assignment and transfer processes o Return, refresh, and disposal workflows • Establish data model and governance, including: o Hardware models and categories o Asset–CI relationships aligned with CMDB o Ownership and accountability structure • Define reporting and KPIs (inventory accuracy, lifecycle status, asset utilization, aging, etc.)
  
4\. HAM Pro Configuration Implementation • Lead hands\-on configuration of HAM Pro from the ground up, including: o HAM Pro activation and foundational setup o Guided setup execution o Lifecycle workflows and process automation o Stockroom and inventory management o Asset tracking and movement controls • Configure hardware normalization and content services • Ensure proper setup of: o Model normalization o Manufacturer/product data standardization o Lifecycle attribute enrichment • Configure integrations or define requirements for upstream/downstream systems (e.g., procurement, discovery tools, HR systems)
  
5\. Process Mapping Gap Resolution • Map current processes to the proposed ServiceNow design • Identify mismatches between existing practices and HAM Pro capabilities • Recommend and drive process improvements or standardization • Ensure solution is operationally practical and sustainable
  
6\. Testing Validation • Develop and execute end\-to\-end lifecycle test scenarios • Validate: o Asset creation, receiving, assignment, movement, and retirement o Stockroom and inventory transactions o Data quality and normalization outcomes • Support UAT and resolve defects or gaps • Ensure a fully functional, production\-ready solution
  
**7\. Documentation Knowledge Transfer • Deliver:** o Solution design documentation o Configuration documentation o Process flows and SOPs • Conduct knowledge transfer sessions for platform and operations teams • Enable internal teams to independently operate and enhance HAM Pro post go\-live Required Qualifications • 5\+ years of ServiceNow platform experience • Proven experience implementing ServiceNow HAM Pro in an enterprise environment • Strong understanding of: o Hardware asset lifecycle management o CMDB and asset relationships o ServiceNow data model (assets, models, CIs) • Hands\-on experience with: o HAM Pro configuration and lifecycle workflows o Hardware normalization and content services o Stockroom and inventory management • Experience integrating HAM with: o Procurement systems o Discovery/CMDB data sources • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills
  
  

**Why Join Us:**  

* Be part of a high\-impact team driving digital transformation across industries.
* Work with top\-tier clients and cutting\-edge ServiceNow solutions.
* Collaborate with experts in advisory, architecture, and delivery.
* Enjoy a flexible, remote\-friendly work environment with growth opportunities.


About NTT DATA
  
  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact\-us.
